documentedBreaches.title: Keep consumed verdicts inside the verified rooted boundary
documentedBreaches.standard: AGENTS.md engineering principles3/4/5; preregistered release-consumer failure#3 requires rooted opens during replacement.
documentedBreaches.reason: The verified root is closed, then verdict/capture files are reopened by mutable ordinary paths. A later case/ancestor replacement can escape the bundle or substitute unverified bytes.
documentedBreaches.requestedChange: Read consumed artifacts through a pinned rooted bounded reader authenticating expected inventory hashes, or retain immutable verified bytes, including subsequent Bundle consumers.

documentedBreaches.title: Compare exact unique enumerated inventory membership
documentedBreaches.standard: AGENTS.md engineering principles5/9: concurrent correctness and verifiable exact artifact inventory.
documentedBreaches.reason: Only a visited-file count is compared with declaration length; streamed directory enumeration may repeat names under concurrent modification, hiding another unvisited declared key.
documentedBreaches.requestedChange: Track and reject repeated enumerated artifact names, then compare the exact seen key set with declared inventory.

positiveObservations: Raw IDs retained; only a single benign trailing directory separator accepted; lexical aliases rejected.
Pinned rooted component opens, Lstat/SameFile checks, nonblocking regular-file reads and finite streaming bounds.
Descriptor cleanup and bounded recursion appear correct.
Typed M3/GLM importers remain unchanged; old actual command results remain historical.
scope: Pinned release-consumer source delta only; broader L/Jev applicability becomes historical; no current full-suite or release certification.
